property_summary: The return value of transfer is always true when the function completes without revert.
C.transfer returns true when it completes without revert.
transfer returns true when all requirements are met and no call reverts
transfer returns true when all requirements are met and no external call reverts
The transfer function returns true when all require statements pass and the loop completes without reverting.
The transfer function returns the same value when called with identical arguments and the caller is authorized.
transfer returns true when the caller is 0x9797055B68C5DadDE6b3c7d5D80C9CFE2eecE6c9 and all inputs pass requirements, without reverting
For any array of addresses and values passed to transfer, if an element of the values array is non-zero, the multiplication by 1e18 must not overflow (the division check ensures this).
Only the hardcoded from address can successfully call transfer without reverting.
The transfer function must revert when called by any address other than the hardcoded from address.
The transfer function reverts for callers other than the hardcoded from address
The return value of transfer is always true when called by the from address, regardless of inputs.
